title: Confident but measured tone
body: Write in a clear, confident and reassuring tone. Avoid hype language that lacks evidence.

title: Avoid exaggerated claims
body: Do not cast the product as universally perfect or effortless when the claim is not supported.

title: Use approved product naming
body: Use the approved name Inkloom Pro 2 and never the older unapproved term 'Inkloom Max'.

title: Replace hype words
body: Prefer plain, factual wording instead of hype terms like guaranteed, best-in-class, or can't-miss.

title: Battery claim threshold
body: Any battery claim must match official approved facts and plainly state the measured duration.

title: Pricing accuracy
body: Price claims must match the current approved pricing and include the correct currency unit.

title: Brand palette
body: Use the approved palette and keep visuals aligned with the Inkloom brand system.

title: Readable contrast
body: Body copy must maintain accessible contrast and alt text for non-decorative images.
